description: This file defines the Wayland display and surface management classes, including interface declarations, internal data structures, and method signatures for handling Wayland surfaces, EGL contexts, and input events within a C++ abstraction layer.

classes.name: Thunder::Wayland::Display
classes.description: Represents a Wayland display server connection, managing surfaces, input, EGL contexts, and internal state.

classes.name: Thunder::Wayland::Display::ICallback
classes.description: Interface for callback notifications related to surface attachment and detachment.

classes.name: Thunder::Wayland::Display::Surface
classes.description: Abstraction for a Wayland surface, providing methods for manipulation and event handling.

classes.name: Thunder::Wayland::Display::Image
classes.description: Represents an EGL image associated with a surface, with reference counting.

classes.name: Thunder::Wayland::Display::SurfaceImplementation
classes.description: Concrete implementation of a Wayland surface, managing native resources, rendering, and state.

classes.name: Thunder::Wayland::Display::ImageImplementation
classes.description: Implementation of an EGL image with reference counting and EGL resource management.

classes.name: Thunder::Wayland::Display::CriticalSection
classes.description: Mutex wrapper for thread-safe access within the display class.

methods.name: Display()
methods.description: Constructor initializing the display object, setting up Wayland and EGL resources.

methods.name: ~Display()
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up resources.

methods.name: AddRef()
methods.description: Increments reference count for lifetime management.

methods.name: Release()
methods.description: Decrements reference count and deletes object if count reaches zero.

methods.name: Native()
methods.description: Returns the native EGL display handle.

methods.name: Name()
methods.description: Returns the display name.

methods.name: FileDescriptor()
methods.description: Returns the file descriptor for the display connection.

methods.name: Process()
methods.description: Processes Wayland events.

methods.name: Create()
methods.description: Creates a new surface with specified parameters.

methods.name: SurfaceByName()
methods.description: Retrieves a surface by its name.

methods.name: LoadSurfaces()
methods.description: Loads existing surfaces from the Wayland server.

methods.name: Create()
methods.description: Creates an EGL image from a texture.

methods.name: Process()
methods.description: Runs the event processing loop.

methods.name: Signal()
methods.description: Signals the display event loop.

methods.name: GetDisplay()
methods.description: Returns the EGL display handle.

methods.name: Constructed()
methods.description: Handles surface construction events.

methods.name: Destructed()
methods.description: Handles surface destruction events.

methods.name: Dimensions()
methods.description: Updates surface dimensions and properties.

methods.name: FocusKeyboard()
methods.description: Sets keyboard focus to a surface.

methods.name: FocusPointer()
methods.description: Sets pointer focus to a surface.

methods.name: KeyMapConfiguration()
methods.description: Updates key mapping configuration for all surfaces.

methods.name: Key()
methods.description: Handles key press events.

methods.name: Modifiers()
methods.description: Handles modifier key state changes.

methods.name: Repeat()
methods.description: Sets key repeat rate and delay.

methods.name: SendPointerPosition()
methods.description: Sends pointer position events.

methods.name: SendPointerButton()
methods.description: Sends pointer button events.
